description: Several risks point to unstable schemas, inconsistent data structures, and frequent source system changes that threaten downstream accuracy and pipeline reliability.

risks.reason: Inconsistent and evolving schemas directly create breakage in ETL flows and analytics accuracy.
Lack of data ownership results in inaccurate or unvalidated data being propagated across the system.
Frequent Salesforce field modifications are a primary source of schema drift and pipeline instability.

description: These risks share a pattern of organizational and workflow-related blockers—security reviews, cross-team alignment, and communication gaps—which slow progress and introduce uncertainty into delivery timelines.

risks.reason: Dependencies on multiple teams for integration create coordination delays.
Security review cycles regularly extend timelines and introduce approval bottlenecks.
UI/UX dependencies create rework cycles and slow interface delivery.

description: Risks within this theme relate to system performance, infrastructure limitations, and the ability to handle real-time or high-volume workloads without degradation.

risks.reason: Real-time ETL requirements exceed current infrastructure capabilities.
Dashboard performance issues may impact user experience and violate SLA expectations.
Backend capacity constraints pose a risk to throughput scalability.

description: Some risks center around ensuring a consistent, predictable, and aligned product experience for end users.

risks.reason: Branding and design inconsistencies contribute to fragmented user experience and churn risk.
